hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(git push|gh pr (create|edit))' || exit 0; echo 'Waiting for CI run to register...'; sleep 5; gh run list --limit 5; RUNID=$(gh run list --limit 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$RUNID" ] && gh run watch "$RUNID" --exit-status || true
